/write with -c, -l, -i, -d and -s, $read by line, scan and wildcard, $lines, $readn, and INI files.
-- origin --
spec
-- script.mrc --
alias test {
  write -c t.txt first line
  write t.txt mirc rocks
  write t.txt third
  write -il2 t.txt inserted
  echo -s lines: $lines(t.txt)
  echo -s r: $read(t.txt, 2)
  echo -s r: $read(t.txt, s, mirc) at $readn
  echo -s r: $read(t.txt, w, th*)
  write -dl1 t.txt
  write -l1 t.txt replaced
  echo -s r: $read(t.txt, n, 1) / $read(t.txt, 3)
  write t.txt $!me
  echo -s r: $read(t.txt, n, 4) / $read(t.txt, nt, 4)
  writeini t.ini Section key value one
  writeini t.ini Section other 2
  echo -s ini: $readini(t.ini, Section, key) $ini(t.ini, 0) $ini(t.ini, Section, 0) $ini(t.ini, 1, 2)
  remini t.ini Section key
  echo -s ini: $ini(t.ini, Section, 0) $iif($readini(t.ini, Section, key) == $null,gone)
  echo -s exists: $isfile(t.txt) $isfile(nope.txt) $nopath(a/b/c.txt)
}
-- output --
lines: 4
r: inserted
r: rocks at 3
r: third
r: replaced / third
r: $me / $me
ini: value one 1 2 other
ini: 1 gone
exists: $true $false c.txt
